scenario: A satellite archive keeps image files only if they exceed 50 MB. The archive curator wants the mean file size across all captured images.

data.description: Only files above 50 MB are stored. File size is Normal with known sigma 20 MB.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean file size mu across all captures and (b) the fraction of images stored in the archive.
naive_answer: Average file size is about 60.1 MB because that is the archive mean.
reasoning_trace: With alpha≈1.1, mu=50-1.1*20=28 and the stored fraction is about 0.1357.
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(50-mu)/20; return mu+20*norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-60.12
mu=brentq(eq,-100,49.99)
frac=norm.sf((50-mu)/20)
assert abs(mu-28)<1 and abs(frac-0.1357)<0.005
